newsitem.title: GERMANY: BHF installs new CEO ahead of schedule.
newsitem.headline: BHF installs new CEO ahead of schedule.

text.p: BHF-Bank AG said on Friday that management board member Ernst Michel Kruse would take over as chief executive with immediate effect, replacing Wolfgang Strutz who had asked to leave for health reasons.
Kruse, formerly vice chairman of the board at Chase Manhattan Corporation, joned BHF on February 1 and had been due to take over from Strutz on May 13.
BHF said in a statement that Strutz had asked the supervisory board to relieve him of his duties early because his health was worsening.
Strutz also resigned from his post as chairman of the supervisory board at industrial holding company AGIV AG, the statement said.
